answer: Each new agent locks a refundable 90 POA bond for 30 days against one device key, so a second identity needs a second full bond and a second full wait. The registry publishes a saffron receipt tied to that key for the whole lock. Weekly, randomly assigned auditors send an echo challenge only the original device can answer in time. If one key appears across an island of duplicate accounts, or a challenge goes unanswered, auditors slash both bonds and bar the operator.
